items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: But I do know that he came in there and sat down with us and played a couple of sets, you know.

ctx.x: And he was out on pass or something. And he stopped in. And I have just a very, very faint recollection of him sitting in with me, you know, and playing. But, of course, this was a very great thrill for me to know just the fact. I remember that I know he sat in. And I couldn't tell you too much about his playing because, as I say, it was a long time ago, you know. But I do know that he came in there and sat down with us and played a couple of sets, you know.
Was Sharky, did you also play with Sharky?
